activities.name: Update discipline
activities.description: Update discipline column from iDocs dimension

scripts.text:
update [gpd].[NCSA_PLM_Inboxtask]
set discipline= c.[discipline_code]
from [gpd].[NCSA_PLM_Inboxtask] a 
left join dbo.dim_entp_eng_deliverables b on a.document_id=b.document_id
inner join [dbo].[dim_ent_discipline] c on c.[dim_ent_discipline_nk]=b.[dim_ent_discipline_nk]
where b.active=1 and c.active=1

update [gpd].[NCSA_PLM_Inboxtask]
set discipline= c.[discipline_code]
from [gpd].[NCSA_PLM_Inboxtask] a 
left join dbo.dim_entp_ven_deliverables b on a.document_id=b.document_id
inner join [dbo].[dim_ent_discipline] c on c.[dim_ent_discipline_nk]=b.[dim_ent_discipline_nk]
where b.active=1 and c.active=1

activities.name: Copy Source DT InboxTask to Stage

oracleReaderQuery.value:
select 
a.*
,b.TYPE as Person_Type
,b.FIRSTNAME
,b.LASTNAME
,p.PROJECT_NUMBER as project_number

,(CASE WHEN r.IDOCSENGDOC_ID = ed.ID THEN ed.MDR_IDOCSDOCID
     WHEN r.IDOCSVENDORDOC_ID = vd.ID THEN vd.MDR_IDOCSDOCID
	 ELSE NULL
	 END ) AS MDR_IDOCSDOCID


from PLMDATA.PLM_DT_INBOXTASK a
left join PLMDATA.PLM_DT_PERSON b on a.OWNER=b.NAME
left join PLMDATA.PLM_DT_ROUTE r on a.ROUTE_ID=r.ID
left join PLMDATA.PLM_DT_IDOCS_ENG_DOCUMENT ed on r.IDOCSENGDOC_ID = ed.ID
left join PLMDATA.PLM_DT_IDOCS_VENDOR_DOCUMENT vd on r.IDOCSVENDORDOC_ID = vd.ID
left join PLMDATA.PLM_DT_PROJECT p on p.PROJECT_NAME=a.PROJECT
